composition_check.contrast_review: Yellow keywords on the light shirt retain 5px dark outlines and shadows as requested; reviewed at full resolution. Do not describe all automated contrast checks as passing.

visual_review: Full output sampled each second across two contact sheets; clean 1.2s output frame inspected at full resolution. No large black top/bottom mattes or audit annotations. Clear 12–18% emphasis zooms verified in preflight frames.
transcript_review: Small and turbo ASR outputs compared, obvious phonetic errors corrected, filler/pronouns shortened. No claim of full direct auditory review. The original specified censorship terms were not observed; no unrelated words muted.
